title: World-Record Shot Put
body: On June $$25$$, $$1983$$, shot-putter Udo Beyer of East Germany threw the $$7.26-kg$$ shot $$22.22\, \text{m}$$, $$which$$ $$at$$ $$that$$ $$time$$ $$was$$ $$a$$ $$world$$ $$record$$. $$The$$ $$shot$$ $$was$$ $$released$$ $$at$$ $$a$$ $$height$$ $$of$$ $$2.20\, \text{m}$$ with a projection angle of $$45.0**\circ$$.
